federal_income_tax_brackets_2025.notes: Notice of Ways and Means Motion reduced lowest federal bracket from 15% to 14% on July 1, 2025, creating an effective 14.5% rate for 2025 up to $57,375.

federal_income_tax_brackets_2026.notes: Full implementation of 14% lowest federal bracket for 2026 up to $58,523; indexed thresholds for higher brackets.

federal_basic_personal_amount.notes: Indexed amounts: 2024 ($15,705 max, $14,156 min); 2025 ($16,129 max, $14,538 min); 2026 ($16,452 max, $14,829 min). Tapered between 29% and 33% tax bracket thresholds.

provincial_tax_brackets_all_provinces.notes: Rates and brackets for all 10 provinces (AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, ON, PE, QC, SK) and 3 territories (NT, NU, YT) for 2024-2026 verified against CRA schedules and T4127.

ontario_surtax_and_health_premium.notes: Ontario provincial surtax of 20% on basic provincial tax above threshold 1 ($5,554 in 2024 / $5,710 in 2025 / $5,818 in 2026) and 36% above threshold 2 ($7,108 in 2024 / $7,307 in 2025 / $7,446 in 2026). OHP graduated up to $900 max.

cpp2_second_additional_contributions.notes: Phase 2 CPP enhancement effective Jan 1, 2024. Rate 4% on earnings between YMPE and YAMPE ($73,200 in 2024, $81,200 in 2025, $85,000 in 2026). Max employee: $188 (2024), $396 (2025), $416 (2026).

filing_deadlines.notes: April 30 filing & balance payment deadline; June 15 self-employed filing deadline; March 1-3 RRSP contribution deadline; quarterly instalment dates.
